title: Provision Service Principal
description: Create a service principal for automated access to platform resources

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

Service principal provisioning typically takes 5-7 business days due to security review requirements. Requests with "access_secrets" permission require additional approval and may take up to 10 business days. Make sure to request this well in advance of when you need it.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Service principals are for automated/scripted access only - not for human users
  • Use a descriptive application name that clearly identifies what the service principal is for
  • Request only the permissions you actually need - "manage_clusters" and "access_secrets" require extra justification
  • You'll receive credentials via secure email - store them in your organization's secret management system
  • Service principals can be rotated - contact support if you need to regenerate credentials
  • Each service principal is tied to a specific workspace - request a new one for each workspace you need
